description: This seminar trains students to process and interpret electroencephalography (EEG) and event-related potential (ERP) data using MATLAB. The course has two tracks: an ERP Theory track in which students lead discussions on major ERP components -- their cognitive significance, neural generators, and research applications -- and a Technical Skills track consisting of weekly MATLAB labs that walk students through the complete EEG/ERP processing pipeline, from raw data to publication-quality figures. Students work with real electrophysiological recordings from the ERP CORE dataset and complete a final project in which they conduct a full ERP analysis of an assigned component. Prerequisites: PSYCH 125 and PSYCH 230.
